summary: Recommended shape: ship NAME as a Claude Code PLUGIN front door (2-command marketplace install; Phase-7 packaging already ~90% done), with MCP-server-only as the documented desktop/hookless fallback (mcp-graph.js self-boots the daemon, so it's the same codebase at a shallower depth) and git clone for contributors — while trimming the v1 default surface to the moats (bi-temporal record_decision/supersede/as_of, two-tier typed-edge handoff, metric/judge/merge loop, ghost edges, live DAG) and cutting what we're deleting (classify.sh router hook out of default hooks.json, orch-gate to opt-in, loop budget plumbing de-headlined). The 5-min wow is two beats: (1) complete task A → task B's drawer already holds A's summary as inherited context; (2) supersede a decision → search_knowledge as_of returns the old fact stamped validTo/supersededBy. Top cleanup blockers (P0): README is '# Darwin' + 36KB dev-log with a folder-copy install instruction that would copy certs/key.pem — full rewrite + rename; hardcoded /Users/imyu in 5 source files (bench-arm.js, bench-heldout.js, ingest-git.js, note-web-maint.js, context-gate-regression.test.js); unexpandable tilde in mcp.sample.json args; package.json private/no-version/no-engines/no-test-script; 8 uncommitted files. P1: MiniLM warm-up at daemon boot (first gated search ~90s = demo killer), bench username sanitation, smoke.sh writes into real ~/.claude. Corrections: gitignore already excludes all secrets/state (clone is clean); bench receipts are INSIDE the repo (only the frequency study is workspace-level); the context gate IS live in /search?gated=1 (daemon.js:1214) — only auto-consult is unwired. item.title: Wedge decision: plugin front door, MCP-only fallback, repo for contributors
item.value: Primary ship = Claude Code PLUGIN (2-command install via /plugin marketplace add + install; Phase-7 packaging already done: .claude-plugin/plugin.json, hooks.json, ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} paths, bundled skills). MCP-server-only is NOT a fork — mcp-graph.js self-boots the daemon, so the .mcp.json-only install IS the plugin minus hooks (desktop/hookless path). git clone = contributor path. One codebase, two documented install depths.

item.title: Repo is closer to shippable than assumed; risk is in tracked source, not state
item.value: .gitignore already excludes ALL runtime state (certs/, token, overlay/, sessions/, worktrees/, models/, agents.json, loops.json, *.log) — a git clone leaks no secrets. Real blockers: README h1 is '# Darwin' (36KB internal dev log with a folder-copy install instruction that WOULD copy key.pem); hardcoded /Users/imyu in 5 source files (scripts/bench-arm.js:19,48, bench-heldout.js:18,21, ingest-git.js:12, note-web-maint.js:13, test/context-gate-regression.test.js); mcp.sample.json uses unexpandable tilde in MCP args; package.json has private:true, no version/engines/test script; 8 files uncommitted at HEAD. Bench receipts (1.3MB) are INSIDE the repo already — only the frequency study files sit at workspace level.

item.title: v1 surface trim: don't ship what we're deleting
item.value: Cut from default plugin hooks.json: classify.sh prompt router (routing smarts = substrate-owned, and an invasive UserPromptSubmit injection is a bad stranger first-run); orch-gate.sh exit-2 edit gate becomes documented opt-in. De-headline orch-loop budget plumbing (native Task Budgets subsume). Keep the moats: bi-temporal record_decision/supersede/as_of, typed weighted context edges + two-tier handoff, metric/judge/merge loop, ghost edges, live DAG. Bonus: fewer always-loaded MCP tools shrinks schema payload — our own bench proved payload size is the entire ON-cost (1.63x→1.03x).

item.title: 5-minute wow = two beats: context inheritance + as-of time travel
item.value: Demo script: install plugin → daemon auto-boots → plan feature (tasks appear live in DAG) → BEAT 1: complete task A with summary, task B's drawer already shows A's summary as Tier-1 context and B flips ready. BEAT 2: record_decision (SQLite), then record_decision(supersedes) (Postgres), then search_knowledge as_of=<5min ago> returns the OLD fact with validTo/supersededBy stamps — 'project memory with an undo-history'. Cold-flawless requirements: empty-state dashboard, lexical fallback before MiniLM downloads, model warm-up at daemon boot (first gated search is ~90s otherwise — demo killer), port-conflict handling, supersede round-trip via MCP only.

item.title: Fact corrections found during audit
item.value: (1) Context gate IS wired into the live daemon path — daemon.js:1214 calls gateTask for /search?gated=1 (search_knowledge gated:true); the 'offline prototype' framing is stale. What's NOT wired is auto-consult-on-task-start. Market as 'gated retrieval, abstains by default'. (2) MiniLM is not vendored: models/ is gitignored, weights download at runtime from HF hub (Apache-2.0, ~25MB) — no redistribution/licensing issue, but a first-use latency issue. (3) test/smoke.sh writes fixture dirs into the user's real ~/.claude/projects and ~/.claude/tasks — fix or document before inviting contributors.
